<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/secret/{name}"}
  context={"endpoint"}

Deletes a secret of the organization, even when configs still reference it: the response lists the agents and campaigns whose config names it, which will fail to launch on the cloud until it is set again.
